decisions.reason: As a core-looking formwork system that survived the initial screening phase and fits the firm's modular factory solutions, it is relatively cheap to keep as an option and has enough strategic fit to justify continuation.
This shuttering magnet block appears to be a complementary component with low carrying cost, so despite more limited website prominence the firm would likely keep it unless sales clearly disappoint.
Because it had its own product page and matches the firm's established magnetic formwork and automation portfolio, the evidence points to a viable option worth retaining.

Although it seems less central than the more prominently presented products, its close fit with the firm's modular offering and the low cost of maintaining such a component support keeping it on the market for now.
